name: Magboro

queries.query: Nigeria official cadastral parcel map viewer Magboro Ogun State OLARMS GIS Ogun SDI
queries.result: First-party results identified Ogun State Government's Land Admin/e-GIS and OLARMS links, the Ogun SDI GeoNode catalogue, and the Ogun Property Recognition System (OGPRS). OGPRS describes property polygons and property IDs, but no verified public cadastral parcel feature endpoint was obtained. The Ogun SDI catalogue and API were reachable anonymously; a bounded resource listing exposed maps/documents but no Magboro parcel dataset or parcel feature response.

queries.query: Maapu cadastral ati awọn ilẹ Magboro Ogun Nigeria OLARMS GIS ilẹ ilẹ̀
queries.result: No distinct first-party Yoruba-language cadastral viewer or Magboro parcel API was found. Ogun State's official English portal states that Yoruba is the lingua franca of the state; the official land/e-GIS and survey/GIS routes found were English-language services. This language search therefore yielded the same official Ogun State routes and no additional public parcel geometry source.

registryBasis: Ogun State land administration and GIS services are evidenced, but no Magboro-specific local registry, public parcel viewer, or verified anonymous parcel-feature response was evidenced. Therefore registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official state portal exposes Land Admin/e-GIS, OLARMS, Office of the Surveyor General, and planning routes; it does not itself expose parcel geometry.

Public GeoNode catalogue loaded. Its current page configuration exposed EPSG:3857 as the default map CRS, GeoNode API v2 at /api/v2/, and a GeoServer public base URL. The bounded anonymous /api/v2/resources listing returned 61 resources, primarily maps/documents, without a Magboro parcel dataset or parcel geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Search result describes property polygons around a search area and a Property ID (PID), but ordinary HTTPS retrieval failed certificate verification because the host certificate was expired. No certificate exception was used.

officialSources.publisher: Office of the Surveyor-General of the Federation
officialSources.observation: Official federal page describes nationwide cadastral/legal survey responsibilities and a cadastral GIS database, but provides no Magboro public parcel endpoint.
